title: Amazon to expand Prime Air drone delivery to nearly 500 US cities and towns
summary: Amazon said it will expand Prime Air drone delivery, currently live in about 10 US metro areas, to nearly 500 cities and towns by the end of 2026, adding Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta and Boise.

sources.title: Amazon will expand drone delivery to 500 US cities and towns by end of 2026, company says
Amazon set to expand drone delivery of lightweight packages to 500 US cities

title: Claude Developer Platform: Files API, Agent Skills, and Admin API reach GA
summary: Anthropic made the Files API, Agent Skills/Skills API, and Admin API user-management endpoints for Claude Enterprise organizations generally available, removing the requirement for the associated beta headers.

title: Google and Marvell expand custom AI silicon deal, Google gets right to buy $12.2B stake
summary: Marvell granted Google warrants to purchase up to $12.2 billion of its shares, tied to Google's purchases of custom silicon for the TPU ecosystem, including AI inference accelerators, networking chips, storage and memory controllers.

sources.title: Marvell Gives Google Right to Buy Up to $12.2 Billion in Shares
Marvell's stock pops 10% on AI chip deal that lets Google buy up to $12.2 billion in shares

title: Visual Studio Code 1.134 released
summary: VS Code 1.134 ships side-by-side chat groups, a prompt timeline for navigating conversations, in-chat search, and local HTML files previewed in the integrated browser by default.

title: OpenAI announces Private Safety Processing
summary: OpenAI said it is testing Private Safety Processing, a system to detect risk patterns across multiple interactions for paid-tier customers, with early testers including Microsoft and Databricks and a technical white paper expected in September 2026.

sources.title: OpenAI to Roll Out Enhanced Safety Features for Paid AI Tool Users

title: WordPress 7.1 released
summary: WordPress 7.1 shipped on the final day of WordCamp US 2026, adding responsive block styles, hover/pseudo-state editor controls, an SVG Icon API, and an always-iframed post editor.

title: Anthropic to revise mandatory data-retention policy for advanced Claude models
summary: Anthropic plans to modify the mandatory 30-day data-retention policy it introduced in June for its most capable models, allowing enterprise customers to retain that data on their own cloud infrastructure rather than Anthropic's, after pushback from customers accustomed to zero data retention.

sources.title: Anthropic Plans to Change Data Retention Policy for Advanced AI
Anthropic Plans to Tweak Data Retention Rules After Enterprise Concerns

title: Google Pixel 11 goes on sale
summary: The Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL, announced August 12 at a Made by Google event, become available for purchase at the Google Store and retail partners.
